content.text: {"answer":"Tier 1","citations":["D033","D042","D002","D115"],"explanation":"The signed affiliate amendment moved Marrow Agrisupply to Tier 1 effective October 15, 2025, and the May 1, 2026 renewal kept the affiliate's seats and SLA from that amendment.
